description: float arithmetic and Serial.print(float) formatting; double is the 32-bit float.
basis: Recorded once on Arduino Uno R3 (genuine, USB 2341:0043) (serial output, arduino-cli 1.5.1, arduino:avr@1.8.8). Previous basis: Print::printFloat of the pinned core executed step by step in IEEE 754 single precision (independent Python model with float32 rounding after every operation), which is also what avr-libc's soft-float computes for these operands
